one_line_description: GoHighLevel is a marketing, ads, email, and social platform that provides APIs for authentication, webhooks, and integration with other systems.
auth_notes: Private Integration Token (PIT) and OAuth 2.0 are the recommended authentication methods.
gate_detail: OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens (PIT) are available across plans.

evidence.quote_snippet: The APIs support contacts, conversations, calendars, workflows, payments, webhooks, and more.
Private Integration Token (PIT). Best for your own scripts and internal tools that touch one agency or one sub-account.
OAuth 2.0. Required when you're building a Marketplace app that many agencies or sub-accounts will install.
